024import java.util.Hashtable;
025import java.util.Stack;
026
027import org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager;
028import org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger;
029
030/**
031 * A generic implementation of <code>InitableBroker</code>.
032 * Functionality provided by the broker includes:
033 *
034 * <ul>
035 *
036 * <li>Maintaining single instance of each <code>Initable</code> in
037 * the system.</li>
038 *
039 * <li>Early initialization of <code>Initables</code> during system
040 * startup.</li>
041 *
042 * <li>Late initialization of <code>Initables</code> before they are
043 * used.</li>
044 *
045 * <li>Providing instances of <code>Initables</code> to requesting
046 * parties.</li>
047 *
048 * <li>Maintaining dependencies between <code>Initables</code> during
049 * early initialization phases, including circular dependencies
050 * detection.</li>
051 *
052 * </ul>
053 *
054 * @author <a href="mailto:burton@apache.org">Kevin Burton</a>
055 * @author <a href="mailto:krzewski@e-point.pl">Rafal Krzewski</a>
056 * @author <a href="mailto:hps@intermeta.de">Henning P. Schmiedehausen</a>
057 * @version $Id$
058 */
059public abstract class BaseInitableBroker
060        implements InitableBroker
061{
062    /** A repository of Initable instances. */
063    protected Hashtable<String, Initable> initables = new Hashtable<>();
064
065    /**
066     * Names of classes being early-initialized are pushed onto this
067     * stack.  A name appearing twice indicates a circular dependency
068     * chain.
069     */
070    protected Stack<String> stack = new Stack<>();
071
072    /** Logging */
073    private final Logger log = LogManager.getLogger(this.getClass());
074
075    /**
076     * Default constructor of InitableBroker.
077     * <p>
078     * This constructor does nothing. Your brokers should be
079     * singletons, therefore their constructors should be
080     * private. They should also have public YourBroker getInstance()
081     * methods.
082     * </p>
083     */
084    protected BaseInitableBroker()
085    {
086        // empty
087    }
088
089    @Override
090    public void initClass(String className, Object data) throws InitializationException {
091        synchronized (stack) {
092            int pos = stack.search(className);
093            if (pos != -1) {
094                throw new InitializationException(buildCircularDependencyMessage(className, pos));
095            }
096            try {
097                stack.push(className);
098                Initable instance = getInitableInstance(className);
099                boolean instanceInitialized = instance.getInit();
100
101                if (!instanceInitialized) {
102                    instance.init(data);
103                }
104            } finally {
105                stack.pop(); // Ensure class is removed from stack even if an exception occurs.
106            }
107        }
108    }
109
110    /**
111     * Builds a message for a circular dependency exception.
112     * 
113     * @param className
114     * @param dependencyPosition
115     * @return
116     */
117    private String buildCircularDependencyMessage(String className, int dependencyPosition) {
118        StringBuilder msg = new StringBuilder()
119                .append(className)
120                .append(" couldn't be initialized because of circular dependency chain:")
121                .append(System.lineSeparator());
122
123        for (int i = dependencyPosition; i > 0; i--) {
124            msg.append(stack.elementAt(stack.size() - i - 1))
125                    .append("->");
126        }
127        msg.append(className).append(System.lineSeparator());
128        return msg.toString();
129    }
130
131    /**
132     * Shuts down an <code>Initable</code>.
133     *
134     * This method is used to release resources allocated by an
135     * <code>Initable</code>, and return it to its initial (uninitialized)
136     * state.
137     *
138     * @param className The name of the class to be uninitialized.
139     */
140    @Override
141    public void shutdownClass(String className)
142    {
143        try
144        {
145            Initable initable = getInitableInstance(className);
146            if (initable.getInit())
147            {
148                initable.shutdown();
149                ((BaseInitable) initable).setInit(false);
150            }
151        }
152        catch (InstantiationException e)
153        {
154            // Shutdown of a nonexistent class was requested.
155            // This does not hurt anything, so we log the error and continue.
156            log.error("Shutdown of a nonexistent class {} was requested", className, e);
157        }
158    }
159
160    /**
161     * Provides an instance of Initable class ready to work.
162     * <p>
163     * If the requested class couldn't be instantiated or initialized,
164     * an InstantiationException will be thrown. You needn't handle
165     * this exception in your code, since it indicates fatal
166     * misconfiguration of the system.
167     * </p>
168     * @param className The name of the Initable requested.
169     * @return An instance of the requested Initable.
170     * @throws InstantiationException if there was a problem
171     * during instantiation or initialization of the Initable.
172     */
173    @Override
174    public Initable getInitable(String className)
175            throws InstantiationException
176    {
177        Initable initable;
178        try
179        {
180            initable = getInitableInstance(className);
181            if (!initable.getInit())
182            {
183                synchronized (initable.getClass())
184                {
185                    if (!initable.getInit())
186                    {
187                        initable.init();
188                    }
189                    if (!initable.getInit())
190                    {
191                        // this exception will be caught & rethrown by this
192                        // very method. getInit() returning false indicates
193                        // some initialization issue, which in turn prevents
194                        // the InitableBroker from passing a working
195                        // instance of the initable to the client.
196                        throw new InitializationException(
197                                "init() failed to initialize class "
198                                + className);
199                    }
200                }
201            }
202            return initable;
203        }
204        catch (InitializationException e)
205        {
206            throw new InstantiationException("Class " + className +
207                    " failed to initialize", e);
208        }
209    }
210
211    /**
212     * Retrieves an instance of an Initable from the repository.
213     * <p>
214     * If the requested class is not present in the repository, it is
215     * instantiated and passed a reference to the broker, saved and
216     * then returned.
217     * </p>
218     * @param className The name of the class to be instantiated.
219     *
220     * @return an instance of the requested class
221     *
222     * @throws InstantiationException if the requested class can't
223     * be instantiated.
224     */
225    protected Initable getInitableInstance(String className)
226            throws InstantiationException
227    {
228        Initable initable = initables.get(className);
229
230        if (initable == null)
231        {
232            try
233            {
234                initable = (Initable) Class.forName(className).getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
235            }
236            // those two errors must be passed to the VM
237            catch (ThreadDeath | OutOfMemoryError t)
238            {
239                throw t;
240            }
241            catch (Throwable t)
242            {
243                // Used to indicate error condition.
244                String msg = null;
245
246                if (t instanceof NoClassDefFoundError)
247                {
248                    msg = "A class referenced by " + className +
249                            " is unavailable. Check your jars and classes.";
250                }
251                else if (t instanceof ClassNotFoundException)
252                {
253                    msg = "Class " + className +
254                            " is unavailable. Check your jars and classes.";
255                }
256                else if (t instanceof ClassCastException)
257                {
258                    msg = "Class " + className +
259                            " doesn't implement Initable.";
260                }
261                else
262                {
263                    msg = "Failed to instantiate " + className;
264                }
265
266                throw new InstantiationException(msg, t);
267            }
268
269            initable.setInitableBroker(this);
270            initables.put(className, initable);
271        }
272
273        return initable;
274    }
275
276}
